title: Lambda configured: bridge (Px/rx) vs geometric (doubling slope)
key_point: Px = d*G means pubkey (Px,Py) is the elliptic-curve point for scalar d times generator. Bridge Lambda = Px/rx ratios two faces (P and R). Geometric lam_P is the doubling slope at face P (P -> 2P), not d and not Px/rx.
